paragraphs.en: Welcome to my home! It is very nice.
paragraphs.cn: 欢迎来到我的家！它非常漂亮。

paragraphs.en: Look, this is the living room. It is big and clean.
paragraphs.cn: 看，这是客厅。它又大又干净。

paragraphs.en: That is my bedroom. It is small but cozy.
paragraphs.cn: 那是我的卧室。它很小但很温馨。

paragraphs.en: The kitchen is next to the living room. My mother cooks there.
paragraphs.cn: 厨房在客厅旁边。我妈妈在那里做饭。

paragraphs.en: I love my home. It is the best place in the world.
paragraphs.cn: 我爱我的家。它是世界上最好的地方。
